The main takeaway from our work is that
the signaling structure and the set of interest play a role in the approachability problem that is as important as the reward function.

in games with partial information, the signaling structure and the convexity of the payoff set can both play a role in the design of efficient strategies, while in games with complete information only convexity plays a role.
